Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. ACME is keen to kick off the PoC and we want to line up the architecture review (we have infra and security in the room) plus a separate ops handoff with our SREs. Can we lock a 90-minute slot next week for the technical deep-dive?

Time constraints: our infra lead (Luis) is only available between 12:00–16:00 PT on Tue/Wed/Thu. We're also on PST (SF office). Ideally we want a calendar invite with the agenda and any pre-read.

Attaching a short internal checklist.

Thanks,
Ashley
Product Partnerships — Acme Systems

Attachment: acme_poc_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cross-cloud onboarding windows + architecture review scheduling

Hi Ashley —

Great to hear — excited to get this going. We can do a 90-minute technical review plus a follow-up 45-minute operational handoff later the same week. Proposed slots (PT):

- Tue 11/9 12:30–14:00
- Tue 11/9 14:30–16:00
- Wed 11/10 12:00–13:30
- Thu 11/11 12:30–14:00

Agenda draft: 1) topology & routing (20m), 2) KV cache and prefix caching strategy (20m), 3) capacity/throughput & autoscaling plan (20m), 4) auth/KMS/audit notes (15m), 5) Q&A and next steps (15m).

I'll attach our onboarding runbook and a suggested pre-read. Karthik — can you confirm the recommended model variants and whether we should bring the quantization engineer? Dev — I want ops/SLAs on the invite. Marissa, can you join as AM for commercial questions?

Cheers,
Mina
Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_onboarding-runbook-v1.pdf (doc stub)

Mina —

I can join the session and recommend we have a short demo of the dedicated routing fallback and an ops slide for cache warmup. Quantization engineer (Priya) is in EMEA next week so not ideal — unless we can do a short async note. Proposed model variants: rwd-13b-int8 and rwd-7b-fp16 for latency-sensitive paths. I'll prepare perf deltas and a one-slide recommendation.

Also — Ashley's window overlaps with a standing internal capacity review on Tue 12:00–12:30. If we pick Tue 12:30 start we'll be OK.

Karthik
Principal Infra Architect — Redwood Inference
